title: Phones+
description: A Phone mod for fabric 1.21.8 That adds Phones etc.
body:
**Phones+** is a simple utility mod for **Fabric 1.21.8** that adds a some useful (and weird) items to your game. 

While the mod focuses on phones, it also adds a Plunger tool that can launch you in the air and you can also upgrade it with the Plunging enchantment, although it does nothing. It's not just the Plunger in the store but other items too. You can purchase items in your phone using **Emeralds** **(Not added yet)**.

This mod is focused on adding Phones and give you a laugh! The **Phones+** mod is the perfect choice for anyone who wants a modern touch in Minecraft. It keeps things simple and focused. This Mod makes it easy to pick up and start using immediately. **Phones+** gives you a high-quality Phone Mod that is easy to install and even easier to play.

It’s a straightforward addition for anyone looking to add some extra tools and fun to their world. This is a mod that I will continue Developing.

## Features:
### items:
- **Phone**
- **Plunger**
- **Fizzy Drink**
- **Box**
### Apps:
- **Messages**
- **Anvil**
- **Random**
### item features:
- **Fizzy Drink**: Effects the Player with speed 10
- **Plunger**: Launches the Player into the air
- **Box**: A basic item currently being worked on.
- **Phone**: Main part of the Mod, Allows the Player to Send Messages via Minecraft chat etc.
### App features:
- **Messages**: Allows the Player to Send Messages to all players via Minecraft chat
- **Anvil**: An app that is ment to kill the Player with an Anvil, **Reason**: idk
- **Random**: A WIP app that you guess the number to 1-9 and see if your right!


## Future Plans & Upcoming Features
### Drops:
There will be Future **Drops** to this mod containing more items and blocks! One will be **Phones+ Summer n' stuff**.
